## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `71ec4ccb5dff348f4a10acbcbbc93db38489ff64`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/launch.json + ui/.claude/launch.json, docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md, .claude/skills/dogfood-verification/SKILL.md, packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts, packages/types/src/env.ts, examples/app-showcase/.env, scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs (all read at origin/main 471add32df). The remainder, docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json, is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT; read here only to check the items name the new entries correctly and still reach every acceptance clause.

Inputs read: card #29819 body and all three comments (triage, claim, os-dev-report), PR #30154 body and file list, `git diff origin/main...origin/claude/issue-29819-studio-boot-fixtures` (2 files, +57/-8), and the check-runs on the head. The PR body's account was not taken as evidence; every claim below was re-read in the tree.

### ① Derived judgments

- Two new `configurations[]` entries in `.claude/launch.json`, nothing else in the file touched; `showcase-dogfood-3777` is byte-identical — RIGHT.
- Names `showcase-scheduled-work-3778` and `showcase-react-pages-off-3779`: unique in the file, and spelled identically in both checklist items' `fixtures.requires` and steps (`jq` would print exactly the three names the PR body predicts) — RIGHT.
- Ports 3778 / 3779: no other committed launch entry (root or `ui/`: 3777, 5180, 5190, 5198, 5199) or RUNNER.md convention uses them; each entry's `-p`, `OS_PORT=` and `port` agree with each other — RIGHT. No port collision between the three entries, so the step "boot 3778 beside the default boot" is possible on ports.
- DB paths `file:/tmp/showcase-scheduled-work-3778/data.db` and `file:/tmp/showcase-react-pages-off-3779/data.db`: own directory per entry, same shape as the 3777 entry and dogfood §0 ("own port and DB") — RIGHT. No DB collision with 3777 or with each other.
- `OS_PORT=NNNN` exported beside `-p NNNN`: what RUNNER.md asks of every non-3000 boot (the showcase self-URL reads the environment). Since #26243 `dev.ts` also writes the `-p` value into `process.env` before the compile (`portFlagEnv`, dev.ts:535), so the export is belt-and-braces, not wrong — RIGHT.
- `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1`: an accepted ON spelling of `resolveScheduledWorkEnabled()` (`['1','true','on','yes']`, `packages/types/src/env.ts`) — RIGHT.
- `OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED=false`: in `REACT_PAGES_OFF` of `readReactPagesTier()` (`packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts`), read from `process.env` at serve time — RIGHT. It overrides the showcase's committed `.env` (`OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED=true`): `dev.ts:432` loads `.env*` with `dotenvFlow.config(...)` and dotenv-flow's default is non-overriding (a file value is applied only when the variable is absent from `process.env`); the `serve` child inherits `process.env`. The dev's `node_modules` line cite could not be re-read here (no install in this checkout), so this rests on the documented dotenv-flow default plus the dev's direct measurement — RIGHT.
- Command shape `pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p N -d file:...` behind `env`: the canonical checklist boot (RUNNER.md) and the 3777 entry's argv, unchanged apart from the two env assignments — RIGHT.
- No `--no-compile` / `--no-watch` on the new entries: consistent with 3777, but see ④ (should-fix).
- Checklist: `flow-status-matches-runtime` rev 4 to 5, `custom-page-source-tiers` rev 5 to 6, each with a dated history row whose `ref` is `#29819`, and `revision` equals the last history entry (the invariant `check-platform-checklist.mjs` enforces) — RIGHT. The card's third gap (`picklist-bound-select`) is correctly left out: the claim records PR #30128 already re-pointed it.
- `check-governed-merges`: `.claude/**` is the Tier S row (Tier S iff every governed path lies under it); the only governed path here is `.claude/launch.json` — Tier S, this record is the landing condition — RIGHT.

### ② Semver level

The diff publishes nothing: `.claude/launch.json` (agent instruction tree) and a checklist area JSON under `docs/qa/`. No file under any released package, so `skip-changeset` is the right label and no changeset is owed. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body is right: no published spec, export or metadata-protocol surface moves; `Metadata-protocol: none` likewise. No `(widening)`/`(narrowing)` arm, correctly.

Check-runs on 71ec4ccb5d at review time: every completed run is success or skipped (incl. Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Lint · docs & code guards which carries check-platform-checklist, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Plan Test Core shards, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test UI, Type Check · source gates). Still in progress: Lint · ESLint, Test Core (1/8, 2/8), Type Check · consumer gates / debt ledger / workspace. None failed. The diff touches no TypeScript, so the in-progress families cannot be moved by it; the seat should still see them green before landing.

### ③ Boundary flags

(a) `runtimeExecutable: "env"` with `VAR=value` as leading `runtimeArgs` — SOUND, with a portability caveat that is not new. The repo's launch format (root and `ui/`) uses only `name`, `runtimeExecutable`, `runtimeArgs`, `port`, `url`; `ui/.claude/launch.json` `console-build-test` already sets env through the runtime command (`bash -lc "... VITE_SERVER_URL= DEV_PROXY_TARGET=... exec pnpm dev ..."`), so "env from the command, no `env` key" is the committed precedent. `env(1)` exists on every POSIX host and resolves `pnpm` on PATH exactly as the 3777 entry's direct `pnpm` does; a runner that spawns `runtimeExecutable` with `runtimeArgs` runs it unchanged. A runner that ignored `runtimeExecutable` would break every committed entry, not just these. Windows has no `env`, but the same entries already assume `/tmp/...` DB paths and the file's sibling uses `bash -lc`, and the QA containers are Linux — no regression. One residual the tree cannot settle: whether the consuming runner's format also accepts an `env` key; nothing in the repo says so, and the `env` executable works regardless. Answered: sound.

(b) Separate DB for the schedule leg — RIGHT CHOICE; the item still proves its title. Sharing one DB between two live servers would be a real DB collision (two writers on one SQLite file, and the default boot's DB mutated by the schedule run) and would break dogfood §0's "own port and DB". Sequential reuse (stop 3777, boot the switch on 3777's DB) is what the old "reboot" step meant, but a launch entry pinned to another entry's DB path is a collision waiting for the first concurrent run. The title's claim is per boot: the words Studio shows equal what `_status` reports and the deployment runs. Steps 0–3 prove the OFF state on the default boot (Not running here, bound false with the platform's reason), steps[4] proves the ON state on 3778 (Switched on, bound true, a schedule run completes), steps[5] stays on the default boot for the disable half of acceptance[2]. acceptance[0] "on both boots" and acceptance[3] "on the boot that enables scheduled work" are both reachable. One wording seam: acceptance[3].clause still says "the same schedule flow" while requires[2] now says the flow is authored again on the fresh DB — same definition, different persisted record. Escalated as should-fix wording only (see ④); the clause's `verify` is satisfiable as written.

(c) No `--no-compile` to match `showcase-dogfood-3777` — ANSWERED, but the match is the wrong anchor: 3777 is a solo boot; these two entries are, by the rewritten steps, boots that run BESIDE another boot of the same checkout. RUNNER.md's shared-checkout rule says exactly that case wants `--no-compile` (and `--no-watch`). Should-fix, reasoning in ④.

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/launch.json` against the card's scenario — a runner that can start servers only from `.claude/launch.json` reaches each item's path:

- `custom-page-source-tiers` steps[6]: boot `showcase-react-pages-off-3779`, sign in as the seeded admin (`--seed-admin` on a fresh DB), open `showcase_crm_workbench` (a showcase-shipped page, present on a fresh seed). `readReactPagesTier()` reads `false` from the process env, the `.env` `true` is skipped by dotenv-flow, the Console gate renders `CapabilityDisabledNotice`. Reachable from launch.json alone — HOLDS.
- `flow-status-matches-runtime` steps[4]: boot `showcase-scheduled-work-3778` beside the default boot, author the writable package and schedule flow there, read Studio and `_status`, wait for the first run. The switch is read by every binder (`resolveScheduledWorkEnabled()`), `_status` answers bound true (the dev's probe measured `21 bound` and both schedule flows bound). Reachable — HOLDS.
- Port collisions: none (3777/3778/3779 distinct, `-p`, `OS_PORT`, `port` agree). DB collisions: none (own `/tmp` dir each). Env precedence: process env over `.env`, verified in `dev.ts` and dotenv-flow's documented default. `env` availability: POSIX, same assumption the file already makes.

Findings:

- SHOULD-FIX (hits file): add `--no-compile` and `--no-watch` to the two new entries. Both boot through a default `os dev`, which compiles `objectstack.config.ts` into `examples/app-showcase/dist/objectstack.json` under the boot's own environment before starting (`dev.ts` compile block, `OS_PORT=3778` exported into it at dev.ts:535) and runs a watch-recompile loop into the same file. `flow-status-matches-runtime` steps[4] now REQUIRES this boot to run beside the default boot of the same checkout, so the 3778 boot rewrites the artifact the live default boot serves; `dev.ts:836-845` records that MetadataPlugin's artifact watcher on the running server re-ingests the registry, re-syncs DDL + seeds and fires the SSE HMR event on that rewrite, and RUNNER.md's shared-checkout rule names "two runners booting it concurrently rewrite the artifact under each other" as the hazard and `--no-compile` (plus `--no-watch`) as the fix. A runner confined to launch.json cannot add the flags itself. `--no-compile` still compiles when the artifact is missing, so a cold tree boots unchanged; the item's own path is not blocked (the writable package lives in the DB, the showcase re-sync is idempotent, live connector dispatch follows the env not the artifact), which is why this is should-fix rather than must-fix. Same for 3779 if run beside another boot. Alternative: respell steps[4] to stop the default boot first and keep the entries as they are — but that re-introduces the item's old assumption and costs steps[5] a reboot.
- SHOULD-FIX (remainder, lane seat): `flow-status-matches-runtime` acceptance[3].clause reads "the same schedule flow" while requires[2] now says the schedule flow is authored again on the fresh 3778 DB. Respell to "a schedule flow authored the same way" (or note "same definition, re-authored" in the clause's `verify`) so the runner is not left to decide whether a re-authored flow counts as "the same"; the clause is satisfiable as it stands.

Nothing in ④ is a must-fix: every surface change is named right, each item's path is reachable from `.claude/launch.json` alone, no port, DB or env precedence collision, and the one hazard found degrades a sibling boot's artifact hygiene rather than the item's result.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-29819-studio-boot-fixtures`
Reviewed-by: `session_017ihL2ebbZkr2QAEG1x7UC8`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4c396be07fd3352fedcccc11040a2043ce8d8727`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/launch.json + packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/dev-compile-at-boot.ts, docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md, scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs (read at origin/main 471add32df). The remainder, docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json, is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT; read here to confirm the S2 respelling.

Delta review on the previous PASS at 71ec4ccb5d. Inputs: `git diff 71ec4ccb5dff348f4a10acbcbbc93db38489ff64 4c396be07fd3352fedcccc11040a2043ce8d8727` (one commit, parent 71ec4ccb5d, no merge of main; 2 files, +6/-2), the dev's delta report (#29819 comment 6637261898, read as an input, not evidence), and the check-runs on 4c396be07f. The PR body is out of this record's scope (the seat is patching its two stale lines). Every judgment of the first record that this commit does not touch stands as written there.

### ① Derived judgments

- S1 applied: `showcase-scheduled-work-3778` and `showcase-react-pages-off-3779` each gain `--no-compile` and `--no-watch` between `--seed-admin` and `-p`; nothing else in either entry moved (names, ports, `OS_PORT`, env switch, `-d` paths identical) — RIGHT.
- Flag spellings against the tree: `dev.ts` declares `compile: Flags.boolean({ default: true, allowNo: true })` and `watch: Flags.boolean({ char: 'w', default: true, allowNo: true })`, so `--no-compile` and `--no-watch` are the parsed negations (RUNNER.md: the `--[no-]x` spelling in FLAGS is the only proof a `--no-x` parses; both are there). Position before `-p`/`-d` is irrelevant to oclif — RIGHT.
- Cold-tree behaviour: `devCompilesAtBoot()` (`packages/cli/src/utils/dev-compile-at-boot.ts:40-49`) returns true when the artifact does not exist regardless of `compile`, so an entry with `--no-compile` still compiles on a checkout with no `examples/app-showcase/dist/objectstack.json`; with the artifact present it serves it as built and warns if stale. `devWatchActive()` returns false under `--no-watch`, so no watch recompile from these boots — RIGHT; this closes the shared-checkout hazard S1 named without breaking a first boot.
- `showcase-dogfood-3777` left as it was: it is the solo default boot and the one the steps run first, so its compile is the one that brings the artifact current — RIGHT (RUNNER.md's "boot once with the compile beforehand, then every run with --no-compile").
- S2 applied: `flow-status-matches-runtime` acceptance[3].clause now reads "a schedule flow authored the same way" in place of "the same schedule flow"; `oracle`, `verify`, `evidence` unchanged. The rev-5 history row (this PR's own) now records the respelling and no longer says "No clause changed". No second revision bump: rev 5 was introduced by this PR and the item's `revision` still equals the last history entry, the invariant `check-platform-checklist.mjs` enforces — RIGHT.
- Nothing else moved: the diff between the two heads is exactly the four launch.json lines and the two JSON string edits; `custom-page-source-tiers` and the root entry are untouched — CONFIRMED.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from the first record: nothing published, `skip-changeset` right, `Clause-②: no` right, `Metadata-protocol: none` right. The labels on the PR are still `size/s`, `skip-changeset`.

Check-runs on 4c396be07f at review time: every completed run is success or skipped (incl. Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Lint · docs & code guards which carries check-platform-checklist, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint & Repo Gates, Type Check · debt ledger / workspace / source gates, Plan Test Core shards, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test UI). Still in progress: Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Test Core (1/8, 2/8), Type Check · consumer gates. None failed. The diff touches no TypeScript, so the in-progress families cannot be moved by it; the seat should still see them finish before landing.

### ③ Boundary flags

No new flag raised by the dev. The two earlier flags that the delta touches:
- (c) `--no-compile` omitted to match 3777 — now resolved the other way, correctly: the side-by-side entries carry the flags, the solo entry does not.
- (b) separate DB and "the same schedule flow" — the clause now says what the fixture does; the title's claim (Studio words equal `_status` on each boot) is unchanged and still reachable.
(a) `runtimeExecutable: "env"` is untouched and stands as answered.

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/launch.json` against the card's scenario: both items' paths are reachable from launch.json alone exactly as before, and the one hazard the first record found is closed. Attempt to break the fix: a 3778/3779 boot on a checkout whose artifact was compiled by the 3777 boot under `OS_PORT=3777` serves that artifact as built; its connector `baseUrl` metadata reads 3777, but RUNNER.md records (and `resolveShowcaseSelfUrl()` is an environment read) that live dispatch follows the exported `OS_PORT`, and the 3778 entry exports 3778 — no regression on the item's path. A 3778 boot on a cold tree compiles under its own env, as any first boot does. No port, DB or env precedence change.

Findings: none. No must-fix, no should-fix remaining.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-29819-studio-boot-fixtures`
Reviewed-by: `session_017ihL2ebbZkr2QAEG1x7UC8`

**VERDICT: PASS**
